integrity: The analytic derivation is given in RESULT.md and verified computationally only as supporting transcription checks. Closely related generic variance formulas in cited papers are credited; independent audit has not been performed.
limitations: Exact spectral threshold concerns rank-two positive-semidefinite matrices, standard Gaussian sketch and probe, and the fixed three-matvec allocation. The variance ordering but not its threshold persists under small full-rank perturbations. No query-optimality, finite-precision, or Rademacher-probe claim.
title: A sharp Gaussian Hutch++ variance crossover on rank-two spectra
